motions.item_title: Table the minutes of December 9, 2025, Planning Commission meeting. Commissioner Hess seconded…
motions.motion: Commissioner Strong moved to table the minutes of December 9, 2025, Planning Commission meeting. Commissioner Hess seconded the motion.
motions.headline: December 9 minutes held for later
motions.summary: The commission put off approving the minutes of its December 9, 2025 meeting.
motions.impact: The record of that meeting stays unofficial for now. You will not notice the delay.

motions.item_title: Recommend approval to the City Council of Item 7.A., Slope Development Code Amendment. Commissi…
motions.motion: Commissioner Strong moved to recommend approval to the City Council of Item 7.A., Slope Development Code Amendment. Commissioner Hess seconded the motion.
motions.headline: Rules for building on slopes
motions.summary: The commission recommended that the City Council approve changes to the city code covering development on sloped land.
motions.impact: If the council adopts it, people building on hillside lots would be affected. The motion does not say what the new rules require, and none of them apply until the council votes.

motions.item_title: Recommend approval to the City Council of Item 7.B., City Parks, Trails and Open Space Master P…
motions.motion: Commissioner Hess moved to recommend approval to the City Council of Item 7.B., City Parks, Trails and Open Space Master Plan ordinance. Commissioner Strong seconded the motion.
motions.headline: Citywide parks, trails and open space plan
motions.summary: The commission recommended that the City Council adopt a master plan for the city's parks, trails and open space.
motions.impact: Nothing changes yet: the council makes the decision. The motion does not say what the plan contains, so it gives no detail on which parks or trails it covers.
